subjects.label: Catholic imagery and penance
subjects.description: The game's Catholic and Christian framing: penitence, expiation, prayer, Holy Week, baptisteries and religious iconography as the fabric of the world, not the general plot or the art's technical quality.

subjects.label: Andalusian and Spanish setting
subjects.description: The game as a portrait of Spain and Andalusia in particular, Seville, Holy Week processions and Andalusian identity, as distinct from its religious content in general.

subjects.label: Slow and stiff character movement
subjects.description: The protagonist's heavy, slow and stiff movement and the sluggish, laggy feel of steering him; menus, keybindings and the interface belong under controls proper.

subjects.label: Platforming and instant-death hazards
subjects.description: The jumping and traversal sections and the spikes and pits that kill in one touch, including jumps players cannot make; combat and the map's structure belong elsewhere.

subjects.label: Map layout, backtracking and fast travel
subjects.description: The world's layout as a metroidvania map, how much backtracking it demands, whether it earns the label, and how fast travel is unlocked; individual named areas belong in their own row.

subjects.label: Enemy roster and bosses
subjects.description: The grotesque enemy designs and the bosses, their gimmicks, and whether they are memorable, annoying or too easy; the protagonist and the general combat feel belong elsewhere.

subjects.label: Gore, nudity and dark content
subjects.description: Blood, gore, nudity and how dark the content is, including whether it is fit for children; the quality of the art belongs under graphics.

subjects.label: Named areas and optional trials
subjects.description: Individual areas and optional challenge trials that players single out by name as brutal or easy; the overall map structure and general difficulty belong elsewhere.

subjects.label: Parry, dodge and hit detection
subjects.description: The moment-to-moment combat feel: parry and dodge timing, hitboxes and edge judgement, and contact damage from touching enemies; enemy design and upgrade progression belong elsewhere.
